Not yet covered by a check:
12 languages × 368 strings, all complete. But only 60% of on-screen text goes through the translator (420 call sites vs about 276 hard-coded labels).

Languages: Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish, Turkish. Strings missing for the other ~17 languages the real store offers.
Missing or partial behaviors, in the order they matter most.
What was actually captured from the real store, so every score above can be traced.
store home, signed out → 138 requests; saledata, userdata, GetItems batch API identified
real stylesheets via REA asset URLs
14 store stylesheets → loading throbber, carousel, hover and menu timings extracted
home, game, search, community at 1400 px → layout widths, heights and colors measured against ours
six store menus → panel structure, headings, links and animation captured
cart, wishlist, language pulldown → layouts and empty states captured; 29-language list read
17 open fonts vs real nav text → Albert Sans matched real widths at native size (scale 0.99 to 1.00)
library, friends, downloads, settings → client behaviors recorded in docs/rea-findings.md
